text:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall-raj - high error-rate spike detected on model variant alpha3a in us-west-2 (alerts: 5xx rate > 7% over 5m). Pager duty escalation triggered :rotating_light:

oncall-raj: saw it, joining. any customer-facing alerts yet?

sre-emily: yes, a couple of big keys hitting 5xx from alpha3a. Latency also up ~2x for long-context requests. Diving into logs now.

ops-maria: traffic graph shows a sudden rise starting ~2365556000. Top client keys: acct-9812, acct-4455. Could be a request pattern causing OOMs on alpha3a pods.

product-dan: are we seeing hallucination or incorrect outputs, or pure infra errors? need to scope customer impact.

support-jade: 2 customers have live pages in support channel complaining about request failures for embeddings. One is in EU but routed via us-west for model variant.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2419. Priority: P1. Runbook: "Isolate failing variant -> reroute traffic -> apply emergency quotas -> communicate"

oncall-raj: plan: 1) immediately stop new traffic to alpha3a, 2) failover to stable-v2 for affected routes, 3) apply per-key emergency throttle for heavy keys, 4) monitor for error drop and client impact. executing step 1 now.

sre-emily: i'll perform the disable via control plane. executing:```bash
# restrict new requests to alpha3a
redwoodctl variants update alpha3a --state disabled --reason "emergency-disable - high 5xx"
# short-circuit routing to fallback
redwoodctl routes promote stable-v2 --for-variant alpha3a
```

deploy-bot: Command acknowledged. Change pushed to routing config. Rolling update in progress.

ops-maria: seeing immediate drop in new incoming to alpha3a, but there are hot KV caches still being served by alpha3a instances for in-flight sessions. Might see residual errors for ~60s.

support-jade: notifying impacted customers: "We are routing you to stable variants while we investigate an alpha3a degradation. No action required on your side; minimal latency variance expected." sending now. :email:

product-dan: good. we should preserve logs/samples for root cause. add a sample set for eval team.

sre-emily: collecting stack traces and failing payloads now. saving to /mnt/incidents/INC-2026-2419/samples.

oncall-raj: step 2 - apply emergency per-key quotas for the two heavy accounts. using the rate API:```http
POST /admin/quotas
{
  "action": "set","key":"acct-9812","qps":2
}
POST /admin/quotas
{
  "action": "set","key":"acct-4455","qps":1
}```

ops-maria: quotas applied. first account dropped from ~450 rps to ~2 qps instantly. errors trending down. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Alert: 5xx rate on alpha3a reduced from 7.2% -> 0.8% over 3m window. Overall platform latency stable.

sre-emily: confirming failover correctness — stable-v2 responses are healthy and latency within SLO for most requests. There are a few regressions for very long-context prompts; routing policy has fallback to higher-cost path for those. documenting.

product-dan: can we re-enable alpha3a in read-only mode or a small canary later? we should avoid full re-enable until RCA.

oncall-raj: agree. next actions: 1) run health checks on alpha3a nodes (mem, kv cache hit rates, model weight integrity), 2) run a small internal canary (1% traffic) if checks pass, 3) if stable for 30m, consider progressive ramp.

sre-emily: health checks: 1) OOM traces present on 2 pods from recent housekeeping task, 2) model shard mismatch on one node (hash mismatch on weights meta) — looks like a corrupt shard after last patch. suspect blobstore failure during deployment.

ops-maria: i'm isolating those hosts from rotation and starting fresh rebuilds. commands:```bash
# mark hosts unhealthy
redwoodctl hosts set-state host-az2-17 --state draining
# start rebuild job
rebuild-host --host host-az2-17 --image model-shard-fix-2026-03-15
```

support-jade: any ETA for customer-visible restoration? customers asking for timelines in support tickets.

product-dan: say "we've routed your traffic to a stable variant and are rebuilding affected nodes; estimates ~30-45m for full verification." keep it conservative.

oncall-raj: implementing step 2: internal canary policy enacted but pinned to 0% for now until rebuilds finish. We'll keep alpha3a in disabled state for public traffic.

incident-bot: Change log: disabled alpha3a, rerouted affected routes to stable-v2, quotas applied for acct-9812 and acct-4455, hosts draining: host-az2-17. Incident channel will remain open for updates.

sre-emily: RCA notes so far: probable partial model shard corruption causing runtime exceptions on long-context decodes. Root cause likely failed blob upload during last model promotion two hours ago. Collecting checksums and comparing to registry.

ops-maria: rebuilds started. rebuilding one node completed, running validation suite now.

support-jade: updated two customers with ETA and mitigation details. one customer replied thank you, the other requested SLA credits - forwarding to billing.

product-dan: flagging for postmortem: ensure deploy pipeline validates blobstore integrity and adds checksum gating on promotions. Also consider automated circuit-breaker off for model-shard mismatch errors.

oncall-raj: summary for rotation: keep alpha3a disabled public, continue rebuilds, do not re-enable until checksum verification and 30m canary with zero customer traffic. Maintain per-key throttles on heavy clients for 1h.

sre-emily: note — we can attempt a controlled rollback to a previous variant snapshot of alpha3a if rebuilds take too long. command example:```bash
redwoodctl variants rollback alpha3a --to snapshot-2026-03-12 --reason "rollback-to-known-good"
```

ops-maria: snapshot exists. hold that as Plan B.

deploy-bot: snapshot-2026-03-12 restore queued (manual approval required).

incident-bot: update: error-rate stabilized. Monitoring window started. Keep channel posted every 10m.

oncall-raj: handing off to @sre-emily for overnight watch. i'll update PD and close my rotation after handoff. @sre-emily you good?

sre-emily: taking over. will post checks every 15m and escalate if errors resurface.

support-jade: i'll continue customer comms and collect logs for billing/sla team.

product-dan: adding item to postmortem board and scheduling RCA review tomorrow 10:00 PST.

oncall-raj: closing my on-call note: main mitigations done. alpha3a disabled, stable-v2 routing, per-key quotas applied. leaving incident open for verification.

sre-emily: 15m check: alpha3a 5xx = 0.5%, stable-v2 health good, host rebuild ok. proceeding to verification tasks.

incident-bot: INC-2026-2419 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Participants: oncall-raj, sre-emily, ops-maria, support-jade, product-dan.

sre-emily: final note before standdown — keep the disabled variant artifact and logs preserved under incident bucket for at least 90 days. I'll draft the postmortem once we have full checksums and deploy logs.

support-jade: acknowledged. sending final customer updates now. :white_check_mark:

oncall-raj: thanks team. handing off.

sre-emily: thanks. I'll close incident when rebuilds + 30m stable window complete and snapshot rollback not required.

incident-bot: Incident channel archived when status set to resolved. For now: monitoring continues.
